Exercise: Incline Push-Up Reverse Grip

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
push

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- vertical_push

Primary Muscles:

- chest

Secondary Muscles:

- abdominals
- shoulders
- triceps

Equipment:

- bodyweight

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
2.5

Energy Requirement:
moderate

Recovery Time:
1 hours

Goals:

- shoulder_stability
- chest_hypertrophy

Contraindications:

- condition: shoulder instability, description: May exacerbate shoulder issues.
- condition: recent chest injury, description: Should avoid high-impact exercises until fully healed.

Exercise Variations:

- name: Incline Push-Up Close Grip, id: Incline_Push-Up_Close_Grip
- name: Incline Push-Up Wide Grip, id: Incline_Push-Up_Wide_Grip

Substitution Options:

- name: Incline Push-Up Standard Grip, id: Incline_Push-Up_Standard_Grip

Instructions:

- Stand facing a Smith machine bar or sturdy elevated platform at an appropriate height.
- Place your hands on the bar palms up, with your hands about shoulder width apart.
- Position your feet back from the bar with arms and body straight. This will be your starting position.
- Keeping your body straight, lower your chest to the bar by bending the arms.
- Return to the starting position by extending the elbows, pressing yourself back up.
